subtitle: 탱 움직이면 힐 멈추는 투컴 수도원

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
수도원 내내 탱이 멈췄다
힐이 멈췄다… 이거 투컴임?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle 2.5-head cute chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with a minimal stone tile floor shadow. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her) stands frozen completely stiff like a statue holding a one-handed mace and golden shield while two tiny cute 2.5-head chibi SD Scarlet Crusaders tap her shield. On the right, Gnome Rogue (she/her, bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with zero hairpins, daggers sheathed at waist) leans forward exasperatedly, glaring suspiciously at the motionless tank.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
사전 고지도 없이 투컴이면
파티원 시간 다 뺏는 거 아님?
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium over-the-shoulder 2.5-head cute chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon floor shading. On the right, exhausted Gnome Rogue (she/her, bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) gestures tiredly with empty hands in complaint toward the left. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her) stands calmly with her one-handed mace and golden shield lowered, blinking lazily without a care.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
누구 죽었음? 어글 튀었음?
피해 본 거 있냐고
cuts.visual_prompt: Close-medium angled 2.5-head cute chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor touch. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her) tilts her head with a completely unbothered, shameless deadpan stare, holding her one-handed mace and golden shield. On the right, Troll Shaman (she/her, wooden totem staff stowed on back) stands completely frozen stiff like a wooden doll with blank lifeless eyes beside a small carved wooden healing totem planted on the floor.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height in 2.5-head cute chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Gnome Rogue (she/her, bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with zero hairpins) freezes in absolute speechless disbelief, wide blank white eyes with tiny pinprick pupils, jaw dropped wide open, dramatic comic shock lines radiating behind her head and a tiny translucent chibi ghost drifting upward from her crown.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
지금도 말하면서
힐러 캐릭은 멈춰 있잖아!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic side-profile 2.5-head cute chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor touch. On the right, Gnome Rogue (she/her, two clearly separated bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips and zero hairpins, strictly TWO green daggers sheathed at her hip and ZERO daggers on her back) points furiously with an empty hand, shouting in exasperation. On the left, Troll Shaman (she/her, single wooden totem staff stowed on back) remains utterly frozen stiff mid-idle like a statue beside her small carved wooden totem, staring blankly straight ahead.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
탱힐 구할 시간 줄여줬는데
뭐가 문제인지 모르겠네
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle 2.5-head cute chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background showing a comedic role reversal. On the left, Undead Paladin (she/her, holding her one-handed mace and golden shield) is now frozen completely stiff like an AFK statue with blank lifeless eyes. On the right, Troll Shaman (she/her, wooden totem staff stowed cleanly on her back) suddenly animates with a smug relaxed grin and nonchalant empty-handed shrug.
